director.name: 吉格吉德苏伦·贡布扎布 Jigjidsuren Gombojav

introduction: One family of Govi. Ankhaa's son was born because the head of the union committee, who came to spend the night with them, raped a single young woman who was left to take care of the house. He lived with his grandmother. One day, after her beloved grandmother passed away in heaven, she saw the hand of her cold-hearted stepfather and took on all the hard work of the family with her little body. Soon after having a younger brother, Ankhaa's son, who is more and more teased, leaves his native home and runs away to the depths of the infinite world that awaits him. The mother climbs up the sand dune with tears in her eyes, after her spotted baby, who became her lifeline... This film is the third work of the "On the Edge of Doom" series, and it was made in a "silent" format without words.
